notes: Exact first-generation Bowers & Wilkins CM10 (2013 model, not CM10 S2). Sound & Vision's Test Bench reports 88.5 dB sensitivity from 500 Hz–2 kHz; its measurement setup was the passive CM10 with grille, at 1 m and 2.83 V. Its quasi-anechoic response reports a -3 dB point at 49 Hz and a -6 dB point at 37 Hz; the structured lower bound stores only the measured -3 dB point (49 Hz), with no high limit inferred. No plot points or directivity data are digitized/imported. The exact-model Audioholics specification table identifies five drive units (one 25 mm tweeter, one 150 mm midrange, three 165 mm/6.5-inch bass drivers), 8-ohm nominal impedance (3.1-ohm manufacturer minimum), and a 30–300 W recommended-amplifier range. Only the exact nominal impedance and woofer size are stored in the separately sourced fields; the amplifier range is not scalar power. B&W's exact CM10 owner manual supports passive classification through its externally amplified, bi-wire speaker terminals. The Sound & Vision measured minimum of 3.72 ohms at 115 Hz is retained here as context only, not substituted for nominal impedance. Sources: https://www.soundandvision.com/content/bowers-wilkins-cm10-loudspeaker-test-bench; https://www.audioholics.com/tower-speaker-reviews/bowers-wilkins-cm10; https://www.bowerswilkins.com/on/demandware.static/-/Library-Sites-bowers_northamerica_shared/default/dwf7d96409/archive-manuals/cm10_manual.pdf.
